newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI STOCKS FALL IN SLUGGISH TRADE BY LUNCH.
newsitem.headline: THAI STOCKS FALL IN SLUGGISH TRADE BY LUNCH.

text.p: The Thai stock market moved sluggishly throughout the morning session and retreated slightly by lunch break on Friday as uncertain investors stayed sidelined, brokers said.

"Investors were reluctant to enter the market as they were still worried about inflation and the future of financial institutions. They probably thought it was best to hold cash rather than investing in the market," said a broker at a foreign brokerage.
The composite SET index declined 1.98 points to 636.06 on thin 1.3 billion baht turnover by the midday break.

Investor worries about financial institutions came after the government on Tuesday suspended 42 troubled finance firms. The move came slightly more than a month after the government suspended 16 other finance companies.
Brokers said foreigners were also not active as they were also concerned about the future of the rest of finance firms still considered as healthy by officials.
Bangkok Bank topped the active list, losing two baht to 167 and National Finance shed 0.25 to 33.25.
